newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae shareholders to vote July 31.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae shareholders to vote July 31.

text.p: Student Loan Marketing Association (Sallie Mae) said Thursday it scheduled a special meeting of shareholders for 1100 EDT July 31 for shareholders to vote on a privatization plan.
Sallie Mae scheduled the meeting after the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) declared its proxy solicitation materials effective.

Sallie Mae chairman William Arceneaux said in a statement that the management believes its slate of directors will be supported over that of the opposition group known as the Committee to Restore Value (CRV).
In a letter to shareholders, David Vitale said the Sallie Mae business "as presently constituted is a particularly attractive investment and can increase shareholder value without unnecessary risk."
Vitale, vice chairman of First Chicago NBD Corp, and currently a Sallie Mae board member, would be non-executive chairman of the board if the management slate is approved.
